name: Agent of Empires
description: Run Claude Code and other coding agents in parallel tmux sessions with git worktrees and container sandboxes, controlled from a TUI, CLI, web dashboard or HTTP API, for developers.

skills.name: Create Session
skills.description: Creates a session running a coding agent in a repo, optionally on its own git worktree branch and inside a sandbox container.

skills.name: Send Prompt
skills.description: Sends a prompt to a running agent session and reads its terminal output or structured view to follow its progress.

skills.name: List Sessions
skills.description: Lists live or all sessions with their status, group and parent, so you can see which agents are working or waiting.

skills.name: Review Diffs
skills.description: Shows each session's changed files and diffs so you can review an agent's work from the web dashboard or the API.

skills.name: Sandbox Agents
skills.description: Runs agents inside Docker, Podman or Apple Containers sandboxes to keep them isolated from the host machine.
